physical.mounting-hardware: M6x12 screw x4, M6 cage nut x4

base.description: The shelf as FS ships IWEP1U550, with its M6 screws and cage nuts.

description: 1U 19in vented cantilever shelf with a rear lip, FS IWEP1U550: a black SPCC steel tray 441.4 mm wide reaching 550 mm behind the front rails, its side walls 28 mm high at the front and full height at the rear and folded out into ears that bolt to the front rails, with a lip along the back that stops equipment sliding off. Twenty-five diagonal vent slots; it carries 60 kg on 2- or 4-post racks.

gaps.note: no FS document states the shelf's own weight.
the baffle along the rear is named and rendered but not dimensioned; it is drawn 28 high.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned rear or side view

ears.description: the four mounting tabs, the side walls folded out at both ends, front pair first

shelf.description: the floor, its side walls and its rear lip

name: iwep1u550

chassis.note: the specification gives 44.0 x 482.6 x 550 mm over the ears, which is the part: the ears are built in (provenance.ears). The tray between them is 441.4 (see provenance.tray-width).

color.note: black powder-coated steel, as every render shows.

datasheet-header.note: the IWEP1U550 datasheet's third page is headed "IWEP1U350 Vented Shelf Datasheet", an FS copy error; its drawing dimensions 550.

ears.note: THE EARS ARE BUILT IN: each is the side wall's front end folded out flat, one piece with the tray (the renders g1 and g4 of SKU 175749), so under the owner's rule of 2026-10-09 they are part of the face and always drawn - 20.6 each side, the face the full 482.6, with their slots. THE SAME TABS STAND AT THE REAR: the renders g1 and g4 and the datasheet's top view (p3) show a tab with two slots folded out at both ends of each side wall, so the shelf can also bolt to rear rails; the rear pair is drawn on the rear face and seen edge-on at y=0 on the top view. The front is the end with the low slotted wall (g1, the datasheet's application figure on p2, where it faces the viewer); the lip stands along the rear edge, between the full-height ends of the walls.

eia.note: EIA-310 hole positions: the rail holes of each rack unit stand 6.35, 22.225 and 38.1 mm up from its bottom, and the two rails' holes are 465.1 mm apart across the rack. The part is taken as centred in the rack units it fills.

hosting.note: the surface a device stands on is the floor between the two walls, 439.0 x 550 mm (the body less two 1.2 walls), recorded in `attrs.physical` as usable-width-mm and usable-depth-mm; the load is the datasheet's "Weight Capacity - Stationary" 60 kg. Hosting devices on it is #935's.

lifecycle.note: checked 2026-10-09 against what the intake holds: the FS documentation portal's Accessories tree, read on 2026-10-08, carries no end-of-sale notice for this part. The product page (SKU 175750) was live on 2026-10-08. No web search beyond FS's own pages was made.

method.note: the IWEP1U550 datasheet (portal 4869) for the figures and its three-view drawing in mm; the gallery renders, which IWEP1U350 and IWEP1U550 share byte for byte (so no render tells the two apart; depth comes only from the datasheets); FS's Visio stencil (master IWEP1U550). There is no quick start guide.

mount-depth.note: cantilever: the shelf bolts to the FRONT rails only through its two ears (2 or 4 post racks) and nothing supports its rear; its depth is the tray's reach behind the front rails, not a rail-to-rail span.

sheet.note: `shell: sheet`, 1.2: the shelf is bent sheet steel and open air (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4); FS states the material and not its gauge. Its solid in 3D is the floor (a well on the top view, 42 deep in the 44 envelope - the deepest a sheet body builds, so the floor is drawn 2 thick where the sheet is about 1.2), the two side walls standing on it to their profile, and any rear lip; the six views are elevations.

tray-width.note: 441.4 between the walls: the datasheet's top view is not to scale across (its tray reads wider than the 482.6 front view), so the width is taken from the plan render at the scale its stated 350 depth gives.
